Product Overview

One Platform. Endless Possibilities.

The SkyHawk X9 is a modular enterprise UAV platform designed to adapt to your mission. Hot-swap payloads in seconds, fly in rain or shine, and capture data with centimeter-level precision.

Precision Engineering from the Ground Up

Every component of the X9 is designed for reliability in mission-critical operations. The carbon fiber airframe reduces weight while maintaining structural integrity in winds up to 15 m/s.

  • Foldable arms for rapid deployment — airborne in under 60 seconds
  • Dual RTK + PPK positioning — 1 cm accuracy without ground control points
  • IP55-rated ingress protection — operate in rain, dust, and extreme temperatures
  • Triple-redundant IMU & compass — fail-safe navigation in GPS-denied environments
Application Scenarios

Where the X9 Excels

From power lines to crop fields, the X9 delivers actionable data across industries.

Power Line Inspection

Automated corridor scanning with AI defect detection. Identify cracked insulators, corroded fittings, and vegetation encroachment in a single flight.

  • AI Defect Detection
  • Thermal + RGB Fusion
  • 30 km per mission

Precision Agriculture

Multispectral crop analysis and targeted spraying. Map plant health indices, identify stress zones, and apply treatments with sub-meter accuracy.

  • NDVI Mapping
  • Variable Rate Spraying
  • 200 ha per flight

Search & Rescue

Rapid aerial deployment with thermal imaging and high-power spotlight. Locate missing persons in darkness, dense forest, or disaster zones.

  • 640x512 Thermal
  • LED Spotlight
  • Live Video Feed
Key Features

Designed for Professionals

Every feature of the X9 is purpose-built to solve real operational challenges.

Swap Payloads in Seconds

The quick-release gimbal system lets you hot-swap between RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and multispectral payloads without tools or rebooting.

  • Tool-free quick-release mechanism with auto-locking latch
  • Automatic payload recognition — no manual configuration needed
  • Compatible with third-party sensors via open SDK

Centimeter-Level Precision

Dual RTK + PPK positioning delivers survey-grade accuracy without ground control points. Ideal for topographic mapping, construction monitoring, and cadastral surveys.

  • 1 cm + 1 ppm horizontal accuracy with RTK fix
  • PPK backup ensures accuracy even when RTK signal is lost
  • Seamless integration with major GIS and CAD software

Any Weather, Any Time

IP55-rated protection and 15 m/s wind resistance mean the X9 flies when others can't. Rain, dust, snow, or extreme temperatures — the mission continues.

  • Sealed motor housings and corrosion-resistant fasteners
  • Self-heating intelligent battery for sub-zero operation
  • Millimeter-wave radar for all-weather obstacle avoidance

Frequently Asked Questions

Got Questions? We've Got Answers.

The X9 comes with a 2-year or 400 flight-hour warranty (whichever comes first). Extended warranty plans up to 5 years are available. All warranty claims include free shipping both ways and priority technical support.
Yes. We offer a comprehensive training program through our SkyHawk Training Center, including online courses, in-person workshops, and on-site operator certification. Training covers flight operations, payload handling, data processing, and regulatory compliance.
The SkyHawk X9 is FCC, CE, and RoHS certified. It complies with FAA Part 107 requirements for commercial operation in the United States, and EASA regulations for the European market. NDAA compliance documentation is available upon request.
Absolutely. The X9 platform includes an open SDK and REST API for flight control, telemetry streaming, and payload management. We provide native integrations with Pix4D, DroneDeploy, ArcGIS, and AutoCAD, plus a developer portal with full documentation.
SkyHawk operates service centers in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. We offer 24/7 technical support via phone, email, and live chat. On-site repair and maintenance services are available for enterprise customers with fleet agreements.
